summary.whatChanges: Refactors Rollup/esbuild error serialization into a reusable `toRollupError` helper and uses it when building failed file tasks during static AST collection. Transform/parse failures now surface a single error carrying `__vitest_rollup_error__` details (plugin, id, frame, loc) instead of a flattened list of esbuild messages. Adds e2e fixtures and tests.
behaviorChanges: `vitest list` on a file with a syntax/transform error now prints the full transform error including 'Transform failed with 1 error:', the plugin name and the offending file, and exits 1
Failed file tasks from static collection expose one error with `__vitest_rollup_error__` metadata (plugin, id, frame, loc) instead of multiple errors synthesized from esbuild `errors`/`pluginCode`
Error stacks for transform failures are no longer rewritten to `<relative path>:line:column`; the original stack is preserved
`handleRollupError` is now implemented on top of the new exported `toRollupError`, keeping its throwing behavior
risks: Consumers/reporters parsing the previous per-esbuild-error array (one entry per message with a relative-path stack) will see a different shape: a single error object
`toRollupError` returns undefined for errors lacking plugin/frame/id, so some transform errors may fall back to the plain name/message/stack path and lose the previous esbuild detail extraction
`cause` is cast to `TestError | undefined` without validation, so arbitrary cause values may be mis-typed
New e2e assertions depend on Vite/esbuild message wording ('Transform failed with 1 error:', 'Plugin: vite:') and could break on upstream changes
